# Persian Wars map fixture

`persian-wars-map.pdf` extracts printed page 194 (PDF page 203) from chapter 5 by Nadejda Williams, in *World History: Cultures, States, and Societies to 1500*. The simulated learner run set the excerpt's title and author in the PDF metadata. The excerpt and the imported text in `test/golden/pdf-map-soft-mask.md` reproduce material by the University System of Georgia under [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/). [Original textbook](https://web.ung.edu/media/university-press/World%20History%20Textbook-082817.pdf#page=203)

The page credits Map 5.6 to Wikimedia Commons user Gabagool under [CC BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). [Creator's Commons page](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/User:Gabagool)
